name: CH4 Natural Solutions Corporation Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: CH4 Natural Solutions Corporation does not have significant operations. It intends to effect a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. CH4 Natural Solutions Corporation was formerly known as CH4 Natural Solutions Acquisition Corporation and changed its name to CH4 Natural Solutions Corporation in January 2025. The company was incorporated in 2024 and is based in New York, New York.
